init_publicly_callable.meaning: BuilderWallet.init is publicly callable and lacks any access control or one-time guard

caller_is_any_eoa.meaning: the caller of init is an arbitrary EOA

builder_admin_overwritten.meaning: builderAdmin has been overwritten by an unauthorized caller, enabling takeover of the wallet

assumptions: The init call occurs after deployment of BuilderWallet.
The caller is not an authorized party for setting builderAdmin.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether builderAdmin was already set before the attacker's init call, so the pre-state of builderAdmin is not fixed.
Report does not establish whether init can be called multiple times or only once after deployment, so the one-time-guard aspect of the precondition is not fully determined.

limitations: Only the builderAdmin takeover impact (i_takeover) is formalized; the fee-drain impact (i_drain_fees) and incentive-loss impact (i_incentive_loss) are deferred to future claims.
The exact amount of accumulated builder fees is not specified and is not needed for this access-control relation.
Whether the sweep transfers fees to the attacker or to an attacker-controlled feeRecipient is not established and is deferred.
The authorization predicate is represented by the absence of the takeover observable rather than a concrete authorized-party check, since the report does not name the authorized party.
